title: The problem
caption: The nurse has asked “How are you feeling?”; the first press on the big round switch only knocks dully, and all she gets is “…”.

title: Row by row
caption: One press has entered the first Pain & body row, so the other rows dim while “I’m in pain” is lit under the navy Next tag.

title: Then Speak
caption: Seven presses in, “I’m in pain” and “Medicine” are in the message bar, the scan has entered the message row and Speak is lit.

title: Recognised, not recalled
caption: Yuriy cannot recall “wife”, so the goal card sends the judge to the Family board, where “Wife” is lit and says the whole sentence.

title: No hands at all
caption: After the success card, Core’s head-turn panel sits over the stopped board with Skip lit first, so one press moves on.

title: Hear it in Ukrainian
caption: The board turns Ukrainian and says «Мені боляче. Ліки, будь ласка.», while the card that explains it stays in English.

title: Who Holos is for
caption: After a first press “Keep talking” is lit; on an 11-inch iPad the three pillars stack, so the third runs below the fold.

title: On an iPhone
caption: On a phone the board adds a sentence strip, keeps each row at its minimum size and scrolls; the scan is passing the quick phrases.
